description: Gemma 3 is Google's third-generation open-weights model family with multimodal capabilities. Available in 1B, 4B, 12B, and 27B sizes, it adds vision support and improved multilingual performance over Gemma 2.

trainingData.description: Trained on diverse multilingual text and image data. Improved multilingual coverage compared to Gemma 2.

trainingProcedure: Advanced training with multimodal alignment, instruction tuning for -it variants.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Improved performance over Gemma 2 with added vision capabilities. Competitive with larger proprietary models on many benchmarks.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
Newer release with less community testing
Image understanding may have limitations on complex visual reasoning

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied during training.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning applied to instruction-tuned variants.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

access.license: Gemma Terms of Use (permissive, allows commercial use)

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, cloud deployment via Vertex AI, or through inference providers

hardware.1B: Can run on mobile devices and CPUs
hardware.12B: GPU recommended, ~24GB VRAM for full precision
hardware.27B: High-end GPU required, ~48GB VRAM for full precision
